brushSettingsTiming.scope: Wall time for native Swift brush painting only. Setup and hashing excluded. Two paired process runs, each with two timed samples after warmup, per architecture and build.

packagedSnapshot.mode: Existing --snapshot-small AppKit/SwiftUI command from the exact extracted package.

softwarePhases.scope: Three software runs per build and diameter on the same 24 MP RGB8 raster, two live adjustments and 12.5% filtered display preparation. No OS input events or window presentation.
